name: inst
meaning: the world object's instance: WorldObj's InstanceBase header, then pos/rot/record/attach fields; WorldObj_CreateFromResource 0x55b510 fills it for a WAR resource of type 4 (Instance_InitBase, then zeroes rot, pos, record, attachLink and attachedChildCount, and sets partHeight 0x10)

name: anim
meaning: the animation state (Animator_Init, WorldObj_DrawAnimated); its three pose buffers are the nbJoints * 3 AnimJointPose that follow the object at +0x54, in the same allocation
